setting: Human studies decoding produced, attempted or imagined speech from intracranial recordings (ECoG, micro-ECoG, sEEG, intracortical). Same population pattern for M05, M06 and M12 (published intracranial-speech-test-partition pattern). Usual approach judged on studies first public before 2010-03; 2010-03 to 2011-03 is [concurrent]. Off-population: reviews, listening-only, no decoder.

inherited.M01: Overt word repetition is both training and test action; no separate training-time action.
inherited.M02: No training-only signal; labels are the prompted word.
inherited.M03: Per-patient PCA and centroids from 15 trials per word; no calibration across days.
inherited.M07: No language model or lexicon beyond the closed word set.
inherited.M11: Prompted word as reference; trials kept only if judged stereotyped (Sec. 2.2).
inherited.M13: Extraoperative epilepsy monitoring, wired Neuroport, offline.

topics.inclusion_rule: Setting above; design of interest: electrode type and scale (intracortical microelectrodes, clinical 1-cm grids, 4-mm high-density ECoG, micro-ECoG under about 3 mm).
topics.metric: Speech decoding accuracy by electrode scale.

topics.inclusion_rule: Setting above; design of interest: closed-set word classification, phoneme or syllable classification, or continuous acoustic/formant regression.
topics.metric: Closed-set word accuracy and vocabulary size.

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept; this review adds prior_tally_<slug> at the target's time.
